title: Group fixed values
summary: Julia: Group fixed values. Use score 6. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: A tuple is a fixed group of values. You can unpack its positions into names.

blocks.text: Install Julia. Save each example as lesson.jl and run julia lesson.jl, or paste it into the Julia REPL.
Tuple unpacking binds the second position to score, so it is 8.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A tuple itself cannot be changed item by item.
